components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and the returned 'address' is composed from the normalized
            structured lines. On read it is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            when a non-blank value is supplied it is preferred over the flat
            'address' input. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased and common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is stored and returned normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, marks this owner as a declared member of an existing
            household (same last name and postcode, and therefore the same
            household id) so it is never flagged as a possible duplicate. Owners
            may join an existing household either way; a declared member is
            simply treated as a known member rather than a suspected duplicate.
            Write-only; it is not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Derived on read from
                the stored id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The salutation to address the owner by: the title and last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin') when a title is
                present, or just the last name when no title is given. Derived on
                read from the stored title and last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a leading '+'
                and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes. Derived on read from the stored 'telephone', which stays
                raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The pet owner's member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION is the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted)
                registration date, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                the SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone concatenated with
                the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned once at creation
                and returned unchanged; on a collision '-<n>' is appended so distinct
                owners always receive distinct member ids.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D45'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The deterministic identifier shared by all owners of the same
                household (same last name and postcode), computed as the first
                12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and
                the postcode joined with '|'. Every owner with the same last name
                and postcode carries the same value automatically; it is always
                assigned.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection: the 64-character
                lower-case hex SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone, the
                lower-cased email (or empty when absent) and the Soundex code of
                the last name, joined with '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409
                Conflict only when its whole identity key equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and the returned 'address' is composed from the normalized
            structured lines. On read it is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            when a non-blank value is supplied it is preferred over the flat
            'address' input. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased and common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is stored and returned normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, marks this owner as a declared member of an existing
            household (same last name and postcode, and therefore the same
            household id) so it is never flagged as a possible duplicate. Owners
            may join an existing household either way; a declared member is
            simply treated as a known member rather than a suspected duplicate.
            Write-only; it is not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Derived on read from
                the stored id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The salutation to address the owner by: the title and last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin') when a title is
                present, or just the last name when no title is given. Derived on
                read from the stored title and last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a leading '+'
                and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes. Derived on read from the stored 'telephone', which stays
                raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract this response was
                produced under. Always 2 for the current (version-2) identity:
                the region code mixed into the identifiers carries a fixed 'V2'
                version tag and the three identifiers are grouped under
                'identity'. Derived on read.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year (e.g. 'FY26'). The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year. Derived on read from the FY segment of
                the member id (falling back to the stored registration date when no
                member id is present).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points, derived from: 0 to start,
                plus 2 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the namesake
                count is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, and plus 3 for
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (today's fiscal year is
                later than the registration date's fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                the membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more. Capped at creation
                time so a new owner's level cannot exceed one above the current
                maximum membership level among their existing household members
                (owners sharing the same household id); with no existing
                household member no cap applies. Assigned once at creation and
                returned unchanged.
              type: integer

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and the returned 'address' is composed from the normalized
            structured lines. On read it is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            when a non-blank value is supplied it is preferred over the flat
            'address' input. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased and common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is stored and returned normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, marks this owner as a declared member of an existing
            household (same last name and postcode, and therefore the same
            household id) so it is never flagged as a possible duplicate. Owners
            may join an existing household either way; a declared member is
            simply treated as a known member rather than a suspected duplicate.
            Write-only; it is not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The pet owner's version-2 derived identifiers, grouped together. The
        region code mixed into each identifier carries a fixed 'V2' version tag,
        so every value differs from the version-1 identifiers; the user-facing
        'locality', 'timezone' and 'ownerSegment' keep the plain region code.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The pet owner's member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
            REGION is the version-2 region derived from the postcode (falling
            back to the city) with a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in, FY is the
            2-digit fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registration date,
            HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest
            over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and
            CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the decimal digits of
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned once at creation and returned
            unchanged; on a collision '-<n>' is appended so distinct owners
            always receive distinct member ids.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW26A1B2C3D45'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            The deterministic identifier shared by all owners of the same
            household (same last name and postcode), computed as the first
            12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the fixed 'V2' version tag, the
            normalized last name and the postcode joined with '|'. Every owner
            with the same last name and postcode carries the same value
            automatically; it is always assigned.
          type: string
          example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The derived key used for duplicate detection: the 64-character
            lower-case hex SHA-256 digest over the fixed 'V2' version tag, the
            normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when absent)
            and the Soundex code of the last name, joined with '|'. A new owner
            is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its whole identity key equals
            an existing owner's.
          type: string
          example: '3b8c1f2a9d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5061728394a5b6c7d8e'
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - memberId
        - householdId
        - identityKey
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Derived on read from
                the stored id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The salutation to address the owner by: the title and last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin') when a title is
                present, or just the last name when no title is given. Derived on
                read from the stored title and last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a leading '+'
                and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes. Derived on read from the stored 'telephone', which stays
                raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract this response was
                produced under. Always 2 for the current (version-2) identity:
                the region code mixed into the identifiers carries a fixed 'V2'
                version tag and the three identifiers are grouped under
                'identity'. Derived on read.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year (e.g. 'FY26'). The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year. Derived on read from the FY segment of
                the member id (falling back to the stored registration date when no
                member id is present).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points, derived from: 0 to start,
                plus 2 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the namesake
                count is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, and plus 3 for
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (today's fiscal year is
                later than the registration date's fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                the membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more. Capped at creation
                time so a new owner's level cannot exceed one above the current
                maximum membership level among their existing household members
                (owners sharing the same household id); with no existing
                household member no cap applies. Assigned once at creation and
                returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                member id (the region derived from the postcode, falling back
                to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent
                when the region resolves to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the membership level is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived on read.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city already contained between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the moment this
                owner was created. Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard duplicate, has a different
                identity key from an existing owner while sharing that owner's
                postcode and the Soundex code of its last name. A declared
                household member (created with 'sharesHousehold' true) is never
                flagged, being a known member rather than a suspected duplicate.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (different identity key, shared postcode and same last-name
                Soundex), or absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false. Assigned
                once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner is flagged for manual risk review. Derived on
                read and true when any of these hold: the owner is a possible
                duplicate, the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent, or the
                owner's city was over its soft capacity (40 or more owners) when
                this owner was created; false otherwise. An email domain is
                disposable-adjacent when it is not itself on the disposable
                blocklist (such a value is rejected at create) but belongs to the
                same family as a known disposable-email provider: it shares the
                provider's registrable label (the label immediately before the
                final TLD), so a different top-level domain (e.g.
                'mailinator.net') or a subdomain (e.g. 'inbox.mailinator.com') of
                a disposable provider counts.
              type: boolean
